decisions.reason: A formwork profile line close to the core offer, in an expanding firm serving growing prefab demand, likely meets aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search, though missing recent website evidence adds some uncertainty.
Automated concrete distribution control fits the firm's strategic push into automation, and its slack and R&D orientation allow it to carry the product while results mature.
The magnetic formwork strips had their own page and fit the established range, but the 2019 consolidation of other magnetic items shows this family is being pruned, which adds modest risk.

This magnetic formwork component overlaps with Product E, which was already dropped, and had only a mention on the website, so further consolidation is plausible, but growth and slack still favour keeping it for now.
